notes.title: Game Update - 04/17/2025
notes.content:
📢 Server Maintenance Notice 📢

We would like to inform you of scheduled maintenance to ensure smooth service.
Please check the details below!

📌 Maintenance Schedule
－April 17 (Thu) 15:00 ~ 16:00 (Approximately 1 hour)

🔧 Field Boss & UI Improvement Update
To create a more pleasant gameplay environment, we have revamped the Field Boss system and improved parts of the UI.
Please see the details of the update below.

📌 Major Update Details
■ Field Boss Overhaul and Additions
The Field Boss content has been completely revamped to allow more users to enjoy it.
A difficulty system has been introduced for Field Boss quests, and difficulties will be unlocked in stages: Easy → Normal → Hard.
Depending on the difficulty, Field Bosses will be placed on various floors of the Goddess’s Tower and the Tower of Harmony.
■ Field Boss Quest Reward Changes
You will now receive a Hunter Badge upon completing Field Boss quests.
Hunter Badges can be exchanged for equipment boxes via the "Floor Boss Researcher" NPC in Tearin Village. These boxes may contain Field Boss exclusive items.
■ Codex Updates
Boss equipment entries have been added to the Equipment Codex.
New Field Bosses appearing in the towers have been added to the Monster Codex.
■ Tower Reward UI Improvement
The UI has been enhanced to make it easier to visually identify obtainable currencies and gear from reward boxes on each floor.
■ Level-Up Stat Display Improvement
The UI has been improved to make stat increases during level-ups more easily visible.
■ Chat System Changes
The default chat setting has been changed to public chat.
Normal chat has been removed.
■ Attendance System Improvement
A 28-day attendance reward system has been added for users who log in regularly.

🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where summons using certain weapons were not being properly recognized in the Labyrinth of Summoning
Fixed an issue where quest list selections were unavailable due to UI dialog interference
Fixed an issue where the red dot indicator did not appear when opening the premium shop
Fixed an issue where random enhancement text was shown even when there were no sub-options during 14→15 enhancement
Fixed an issue where the ‘Quick Move’ feature in daily missions would move to the wrong location
Fixed an issue where instant movement to the boss was not functioning in the 4th floor dungeon mission of the Goddess’s Tower

We are always striving to provide a more enjoyable gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45285166/e26e76620e737f1307b7f5327fa1a87cd802012c.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming Future Updates
notes.content:
Hello Climbers!

We would like to inform everyone about the upcoming future updates!

Labyrinth Content: Summon Maze
- Summon Maze is a PvE map where challengers use only their summoned familiars to reach the highest floor.
Compete with other challengers, climb higher floors, and carve your name into the rankings!
The ranking season for Summon Maze resets every 3 weeks, and each record will be permanently preserved.

Federation PvP: Alliance War
- Alliance War is a PvP battleground feature where you fight alongside your alliance to conquer the Tower of Trials.
It is a capture-based battle where the team that secures the battlefield’s flags and earns points first emerges victorious.
Win battles and earn valuable enhancement materials in abundance!

⚠️ Important Notice
- The seasonal ranking system is currently in testing and is scheduled to open in early February.
- After the ranking system launches in early February, your progress will be reflected in the rankings upon your first game participation.
- Alliance War operates every weekend (Saturday & Sunday) from 14:00 to 15:00 (UTC+9) and can be played once per day.
- Make sure to check the time in advance and join the battle!

Happy Climbing![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45285166/952132b7f26002da72f2b114a9bbe2b4a74952ce.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Lunar New Year
notes.content:
Hello Climbers!

📢 Lunar New Year Event 📢

🎊 Find the Lucky Bags! 🎊

📌 Event Period
－ 25.1.23 (Thu) After Maintenance ~ 25.2.6 (Thu)

In many Asian countries, the Lunar New Year is celebrated as a significant holiday alongside the Solar New Year. During this time, families gather, wear new clothes, and exchange greetings 🙇, wishing one another luck and prosperity in the year ahead.

To wish all TeeTiny climbers good fortune and happiness, we’ve prepared a special New Year event!

Lucky Bags 💰 have been hidden in various fields and dungeons, including Te'arin Village. Complete the daily quest to find Lucky Bags each day, and burst them open to claim rewards!

You can use Lucky Bags to purchase Hanbok, a traditional Korean outfit. Also, if you log in on Lunar New Year’s Day, you’ll receive 100 Lucky Bags as a special gift! Don’t miss out on this opportunity to celebrate the new year with us!

⚠️ Important Notes

- The daily quest to find Lucky Bags resets at 00:00 UTC each day. Make sure to claim your rewards before the reset.
- The Hanbok costume can be purchased in the cash shop and is also available for purchase with Lucky Bags.
- If you don’t have enough Lucky Bags, you can purchase additional ones in the cash shop.
- The maximum number of Lucky Bags you can obtain from clearing all daily quests and event rewards is 480.
- The event's Lunar New Year Login Reward is based on Lunar New Year’s Day, which falls on 1/29 (Wed).

Let’s celebrate the Lunar New Year together in TeeTiny! 🎉[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45285166/c983b655d7c5892a62ffd81dc4f5517d31a64372.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Winter Box Event
notes.content:
Greetings Climbers!

🎅 New event! 🎅

🎁Winter Gift Box! 🎁

📌Event period

December 19, 2024(After Maintenance) ~ January 2, 2025

Winter has come to Te'arin and snow has piled up.
However, Te'arin village is not cold because the warmth of the climbers surrounds Te'arin.
Santa and Rudolph have placed winter boxes in the Store and in Te'arin Village.
Aren’t you curious about what’s in this box? Receive various gifts!
Oh, and climbers who reach the 7th floor of the Goddess Tower will receive a Santa hat!
Let’s all get together and celebrate winter!
In addition, several events are prepared. Get a box as a reward for completing the event!

-------------------------------

⚠️Notification of items available in week 1
- You can obtain Santa's gift box with Santa Stocking Tokens. 
- You can obtain a Winter Snowflake Token by Dismantling the Santa costume obtained from this box. These tokens can be used to obtain Winter Festival Box.
- Opening a Winter Festival Box will give you Christmas-themed furniture.

⚠️Notification of items available in week 2
- You can obtain Rudolph's gift box with a Rudolph scarf token. 
- You can obtain a Winter Snowflake Token by Dismantling the Rudolph costume obtained from this box. These tokens can be used to obtain Winter Festival Box. 
- Opening a Winter Festival Box will give you Christmas-themed furniture.
Happy Climbing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45285166/627d8e2ea24be25eb6c96b1281eb97adefdd2dac.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Server Maintenance, and Game Updates
notes.content:
Hello Climbers!

📢Update/Event Information📢

We would like to inform everyone that we will be having a server maintenance today to ensure smooth service.

Please check below for more details for the updates!

-------------------------------------------

📌Maintenance Schedule
－12/05 (Thursday) 17:00 ~ 19:00(GMT+9)

-------------------------------------------

👉Updates after Maintenance👉 

Battle Update
- For the Goddess Tower boss, the time until going berserk is uniformly set at 3 minutes, so it has been adjusted to match the recommended actual battle time. As a result, the fun of conquering bosses on the 3rd to 9th floors of Goddess Tower has increased!
- The overall attack and defense abilities of summoned familiars are greatly increased. In addition to the changes above, the defensive abilities of defensive familiars are further increased!

Gameplay Updates
- The reward received when defeating the boss of the Tower of Trials has been increased by 5 times. As a result of the increase in total reward, the rewards for the alliance with the first place boss kill time and the first place guild have been adjusted. This applies from the current season.
- You can now view information about the Tower of Trials in the guild UI.
- An indication that your guild is participating in the battle at the Tower of Trials this season will be added.
- A teleportation function has been added to the guild UI to quickly get to the first floor of the Tower of Trials.
- An indication of guilds participating in the Tower of Trials will be added to the list of recommended guilds.
- Changed the method of giving only rewards for each level based on the number of attendees to a cumulative method that gives rewards for all levels of people who achieved attendance.
- Improvements have been made so that items of the same weapon can be strengthened regardless of their type.
Previously, enhancement could only be succeeded from sword -> sword.
Now, enhancement can be succeeded from sword -> wand, bow, or orb as well. This also applies to shields and books.
- A shortcut button has been added to the arena UI to quickly go to the arena merchant.

Other Updates
- Multilingual support: Although it is not perfect, we have applied multilingual translation (machine translation) of the game text so that climbers around the world can understand it to some extent.
You can change the language in the game options. Supported languages ​​are Japanese / Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese / Portuguese.

-------------------------------------------

In-game Event

🎉 Growth Prayer Event Information: Collect Rune Upgrade stone (24.12.05~19) (GMT+9)🎉

Upgrade Stone Researcher Runes has come to Te'arin.
An abnormal phenomenon was discovered in the dungeon, and the existence of an item called a Rune Upgrade stone became known.
Runes is collecting Rune Upgrade stone from climbers to research the usefulness of this item.
According to Runes' story, you can obtain Rune Upgrade stone by collecting the dungeon's boss gauge and defeating the boss on each floor. It is also said that the more dungeon gauges you collect, the more Rune Upgrade stone you will receive!
Of course, they say they are not asking you to collect it for free. It is said that they have prepared plenty of goods needed to strengthen items, so it will be helpful for your growth!
How about collecting Rune Upgrade stone found in dungeons and going to Runes?
※caution!

⚠️You can exchange the Rune Upgrade stone collected from Runes, an enhancement stone researcher in Te'arin, for the necessary enhancement stones/crystals.
⚠️Runes will be removed once the event ended, so exchange the Rune Upgrade stone before she leaves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45285166/1e5272b3f792e18d70dfc4c764a23940e2723894.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Future Updates Announcement
notes.content:
📢Future Updates Announcement📢

Hello Climbers!
Thank you for your feedback and suggestion!

We would like to inform everyone about the upcoming updates based on the feedback and suggestions we received

------------

💡Tower of Goddess Boss = Too easy to defeat💡
The Goddess's Tower Boss has Frenzy state, where the boss will go wild and perform a powerful attack. However, the time for the boss to enter this state is three minutes in batches, so we adjusted it to the actual combat recommended time.
As a result, the difficulty of targeting the boss from the 3rd to 9th floors of the goddess's tower increases.

💡Summons have no presence!💡
The damage and survivability of summons in boss fights or field battles were less effective compared to the difficulty of equipping them, resulting in low combat utility. For those reasons, here are going to be the changes:

Overall stats of summons will be increased.
Overall attack and defense abilities of summons will be significantly boosted.

In addition to the above changes, the defensive abilities of tank-type summons will be further increased!

💡The rewards from the Tower of Trials are too low!💡

Currently, the Tower of Trials requires a lot of effort to defeat bosses with guild members. However, the first-place rewards are excessively high, while the rewards for defeating the bosses are somewhat lacking.

As a result, this update will adjust the reward structure of the Tower of Trials.

The rewards for defeating the Tower of Trials bosses will be increased by 5 times.

With the increase in overall rewards, the rewards for first place in boss defeat times and the alliance of the first-place guild will be adjusted accordingly

💡How can I get to the Tower of Trials? I want to see which guilds are participating in the Tower of Trials💡

You can view information related to the Tower of Trials in the Guild UI.
A display will be added to indicate that our guild is participating in this season's Tower of Trials battles.
A teleportation feature will be added to the Guild UI, allowing quick access to the first floor of the Tower of Trials.
A display will also be added to the recommended guild list to show which guilds are participating in the Tower of Trials.

💡Enhancement Succession Changes💡
For items of the same slot, enhancement succession has been improved so that it applies regardless of the item type.
Example: Previously, enhancement could only be succeeded from sword -> sword.
Improvement: Now, enhancement can be succeeded from sword -> wand, bow, or orb as well. This also applies to shields and books.

💡How to get to the Duel Arena Merchant💡
A shortcut button will be added to the Duel Arena UI, allowing you to quickly visit the Duel Arena Merchant and exchange your loot.

💡To meet friends around the world: Language addition (Beta)💡
Although not perfect, machine translation has been added to make it somewhat understandable, allowing you to change the language in the game options.
The supported languages are Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Portuguese.

💡Guild rewards and UI improvements💡
Previously, only the rewards for the current stage were given based on the number of attendees, but now it has been changed to an accumulation system, where rewards for all stages achieved by attendees are given.

🛠️Other Bug Fixes🛠️

Fixed an issue where the teleportation scroll could not be used after the Tower of Trials season started.
Fixed an issue where the UI for the Duel Arena Master rank was not displaying properly.
Fixed an issue where mission targets were not visible in certain quests.
Fixed an issue where Mari's "Shining Flower" buff icon was showing as a debuff
Fixed an issue where the [Trial Fragment Usage] count was not updating during record missions.
Fixed an issue where the [Dungeon Treasure Chest Level 5 Achievement followed by Dungeon Clear] was not counting during record missions.
Improved the behavior where certain skills were used in places where they could not reach the target when used automatically.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We will do our best to provide better services, and we will provide further updates in the future!

The following updates will be implemented this upcoming December 5. So please look forward to the upcoming announcements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45285166/1f6f99e87d53f894c83cec5bbac6b586bbab127b.jpg[/img]
